children.name: canvas

children.name: drawArc
children.description: Draw in the selected canvas using local GUI coordinates.

children.name: drawCircle
children.description: Draw in the selected canvas using local GUI coordinates.

children.name: drawEntity
children.description: Draw a loaded entity by UUID or a table with a uuid field (including lh.player).

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: Entity UUID or any table with a string uuid field

children.name: drawGradient
children.description: Draw in the selected canvas using local GUI coordinates.

children.name: drawItem
children.description: Draw an item by namespaced ID or ItemStack model.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Namespaced item ID or ItemStack model

children.name: drawLine
children.description: Draw in the selected canvas using local GUI coordinates.

children.name: drawRect
children.description: Draw in the selected canvas using local GUI coordinates.

children.name: drawTexture
children.description: Draw a texture by namespaced path.

children.name: drawln

children.name: endCanvas
children.description: Close the canvas and resume the previous section.

children.name: getBlockAt

children.name: getTranslation
children.description: Translate a key using the current client language. Returns the key if no translation exists.

children.name: measureText
children.description: Measure text without drawing. Returns width and height in local GUI units, excluding shadow.

children.description: End the current row, optionally repeating the line break.

children.name: horse

children.name: lastDeath

children.description: Add a message to local chat only; never sends it to the server. Strings are literal text. Tables use modern Minecraft text components with click_event and hover_event on every supported version.

children.name: setInterval

parameters.description: Callback receives the registered event payload, if any

events.name: attack
events.description: Reports server-observed damage dealt by the local player, including projectiles. Uses the Damage model with victim and observed health/absorption loss, matched over two client ticks. Nearby hits on each victim are combined using the latest source; unavailable loss is 0.

events.name: damage
events.description: Reports local-player damage with observed health loss including absorption. Nearby updates are combined using the latest damage source; unmatched health loss uses minecraft:generic. Notification matching waits up to two client ticks.

events.name: death
events.description: Reports the server's local-player death notification with position, dimension, death message and available damage source. Also runs when the death screen is disabled (immediate respawn).

events.name: error
events.description: Reports each recorded error occurrence on the next client lifecycle tick, after profiles load. Repeated errors keep their ID and increment count; isNew is true only for the first occurrence. Errors raised by error handlers are recorded without producing another error event.

events.name: item-pickup
events.description: Reports a server-confirmed ground item pickup by the local player. The ItemStack contains the picked-up count and preserves the item's components.

events.name: kill
events.description: Reports a tracked living entity death whose latest client-observed damage source names the local player as attacker. Uses the Death model with victim; message is generated from the observed source. Limited to entities and damage sources visible to the client; this is not the server kill-credit statistic.

events.name: reload
events.description: Runs once after active profiles load, including first world entry.

events.name: render
events.description: Runs immediately before each HUD frame is painted.

events.name: tick
events.description: Runs at the end of each client tick.
